noise_definition: per-region circular complex AWGN relative to the complete captured region power; this is incremental SNR, not physical over-the-air SNR
noise_application: add noise once to each 4096-sample region, then derive the two standardized 2048-sample IQ-model windows from the same noisy region

frozen_gate.eligibility: all member top1 labels are LTE or DVB-T, both labels occur, and ensemble top1 is not WiFi
